 New Zealand vs. India 5th ODI Live Score & Updates
 Welcome to CricketNews.com's live coverage of the fifth ODI between New Zealand and India at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui.
 Toss result: The toss is scheduled for 7 p.m. IST. 
 Pre-match:
 India will look to clinch the series as the fifth ODI begins at Bay Oval on Sunday, November 15.
 The visitors currently lead 2-1 with only a match to go. After the third match was abandoned due to rain, New Zealand bounced back in the series in style as they thrashed India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Shreyas Iyer captained India for the first time in the ODI format in the last match but it turned out to be a nightmare for the new captain as India were bowled out for just 89 runs.
 India's bowlers have been instrumental, except for the last game, where they looked ordinary. Their batting also suffered a setback as they could not even cross the 100-run mark.
 The Black Caps will now hope to build on their last performance and level the series in their second match on the trot at Mount Maunganui.
